M: Bianca, the retail space next door to us will become available in June. That means we can begin the store expansion we've been planning. W: That's great news! After we increase our space, we can finally do more than just sell musical instruments. M: I knew you'd be happy to hear the news. We'll be able to add practice rooms so we can offer private music lessons by the end of the year.

M: Hi. I'm working on renovating the lobby of my office, and I'd like to get some paint for the walls. W: Sure. What do you have in mind? M: Well, I want to paint the walls with one of the colors from our new logo, either green or red. W: Hmm... I wouldn't choose red—it will fade too fast. M: Oh, OK. Then let's go with green. W: Do you have a copy of the logo with you? If I have the image, I can mix a custom paint to match it. M: Actually, I don't. W: Well, if you e-mail me a picture of the logo, I can have the paint ready for you by Friday.

W: Welcome to the Western Airlines customer service desk. How can I assist you? M: Hi. I flew in yesterday from Canada and was told that my luggage was accidentally put on a flight arriving this morning. W: OK. Do you have your boarding pass? M: Yes—here it is. Can I go to the unclaimed baggage area and pick up my luggage? W: That area is past security. I can use information on the boarding pass to locate the luggage for you.

M: We're so happy to have you join our office as our new dental hygienist, Maria. As you know, you'll be cleaning our patients' teeth before I come in to complete the exam. W: I'll also be responsible for updating the patients' files and scheduling their next appointments, right? M: Yes. We use a software program called DentalX for all our patient records. Have you used it before? W: Yes, I'm familiar with that software. M: Great. Also, remember that our office closes every day from twelve to one thirty for lunch, so please be mindful of that when scheduling patients.

M: Next, I wanted to check with the design team about our water-permeable bricks for walkways. I think the bricks will be popular in areas with water drainage problems. But I'm concerned that the final design won't be ready in time for the trade show. W1: Right, we still need to finish the durability testing. Camille, how's that going? W2: So far, they seem to be as durable as we anticipated. But we still have a few more tests to run. M: Great. Please keep me posted on your progress. In the meantime, we should start putting together a promotional video to show at our booth at the trade show. Who'd like to help me with that project?

M: Excuse me—officer? Do you happen to know where rideshare drivers park to wait for passengers? It's my first time at this airport. W: Yes. Drive to the pickup area by terminal A. Look out for the orange sign that says "rideshare." I'm sure you'll see other drivers there. By the way, I recommend taking the terminal bypass. That bridge will take you there faster. M: Great. Thank you. Oh—is there a fuel station near the airport? My tank is almost empty. W: You'll see one by the rental-car lot on your way out.

M: This traffic is really terrible. W: I know. We've been stuck in this bus for hours now! It's frustrating. I wonder what's going on. M: I heard the Day Street Bridge is being worked on. W: Oh, really? I didn't know that. M: Yes. I think it's down to just one lane for the next couple of weeks. W: That's good to know. I'll take the train into the city tomorrow instead, so I won't be late for my appointments.

W: Girard Electronics. How can I help you? M: Hi. I bought a camera from your store last week, but I'm having trouble with it now. W: What's the problem? M: Well, I changed the lens from the standard to a telephoto one today, and now an error message pops up on the LCD screen. W: Hmm. I'm sorry, but I can't know for sure without looking at it, as it could be caused by a few things. M: I could come by this afternoon. W: OK. I won't be here, but one of the other employees can definitely help you. Let me just write a note down. M: Thanks.

M: Hi. I have a delivery of medical supplies addressed to Eun-Mi Park. W1: That's Eun-Mi sitting at the desk over there. W2: I'm Eun-Mi. I've been waiting for these sterile pads and bandages. M: Great. I just need you to sign here to confirm the delivery. W2: OK, sure. Oh, Claudia, do you have time to help me carry these boxes to the storage closet? W1: Of course. I have a patient at one o'clock, but I have a few minutes now. W2: OK, thanks!

M: Dola Commercial Cleaners. How can I help you? W: I manage a new bed-and-breakfast here in town, and I'm looking for a company to wash, dry, and fold our linens. I have a few questions for you. M: Sure. W: How do you work in terms of scheduling? M: We work around the clock to guarantee a 24-hour turnaround time. We run three separate shifts. W: That's good to hear. M: Could I ask where you're located? W: Oh, we're at 647 Pond Street. M: In that case, pickup and delivery will not add to your service charge, since you're within a fifteen-kilometer radius of us.

M: Welcome to Centerville Fitness Center. W: Hi. I hear you're having a fund-raising campaign. M: Yes, today's the start of our annual fund-raiser. M: Wonderful! Just fill out the donation form, and I'll get you your raffle ticket. W: How will I find out if I won? M: The drawing's on Friday, and winners will receive a phone call from the organizers.

W: Hi. Some of us at work decided to get together to buy some flowers here. They're for a colleague who just received a promotion. W: Actually, no card is needed. We already have one that we've all signed.

W: Hi, Andrew. How have you enjoyed your first week here at Jebreen Farms? M: It's been great. I'm definitely learning a lot about commercial agriculture. W: So glad to hear that. Let's go over to where we'll store the upcoming corn harvest. As you know, we sell a lot of corn as feed for livestock farms in the area. M: Yes. I'm eager to get some hands-on experience with drying and storing the corn. W: Good. If the process is done right, it can be stored for long periods, but conditions inside the grain bin have to be just right. M: How long will the drying process take after the harvest? W: About four to six weeks.

Welcome to your first day of work at Schneider Technology. Our navigation devices enable vehicles to direct drivers to their destination by taking into consideration a variety of factors such as distance, weather, and traffic conditions. Moritz Schneider, the president of the company, will be here in person at ten o'clock to welcome you and tell you all about the company's history. But first, I'll help you set up your computer accounts. Cybersecurity is very important to us, so we've added extra steps to verify your identity.

Good afternoon. This is Captain Jeong giving you a heads-up on our plane's departure status. As you can see, there's a light dusting of snow on the ground. Air traffic control is holding us here at the gate while the snowplows clear the runway. It should take just a few minutes, then we'll be cleared for takeoff. I apologize for the delay. And a reminder: please ensure that children remain seated with their seat belts fastened throughout the flight.

Good morning, and thanks for tuning in to News at Four. We've just learned that the Natural Zoological Museum, one of Springfield's most popular museums, will soon close for a renovation project. To those who are planning to visit the exhibits in person, be aware that the workers arrive in six weeks. But if you miss that window, don't worry. You can still visit the museum virtually during the renovation period. Video tours will soon be available on the museum's Web site, and videos showing the progress of the project will also be posted regularly.

At Jin-Ah's Jewelers, we create custom-made jewelry that showcases your style and celebrates the most important moments in your life. Meet for a video consultation with one of our talented artists, who can design earrings, bracelets, and more, just for you. And unlike our competitors, who only send you a sketch, we'll send you a simple metal prototype. You can approve or request changes to the sample before your final piece is made. To get your order started, just enter your information on our Web site, and one of our designers will contact you.

On today's episode of our podcast, we'll be talking to Rebecca Taylor, the chair and founder of Real Estate Investments LLC. As we know, the housing market has had its ups and downs in recent years. Ms. Taylor is widely known for her ability to correctly predict trends in the real estate market. Her opinion is highly valued. We are fortunate to be able to interview her today before she travels to the National Real Estate Conference in Chicago, where she has been invited to deliver the keynote speech.

The topic for today's workshop is writing business correspondence. Business correspondence has different guidelines than the informal type of writing you use when writing to a friend. For example, when writing to a friend you might address them by their first name or perhaps include emojis. You know—symbols like smiley faces that are commonly used to express feelings. However, emojis are considered inappropriate in business writing. Also, business correspondence should always include the recipient's title and last name. Remember, we don't want to offend our clients. Now, I will project some slides of informally worded e-mails. In your notebooks, rewrite the e-mails using wording and style appropriate for business correspondence.

In the world of business, athletic retailer Clementine Stores has filed a complaint against software firm Stephion. Clementine claims that the Stephion logo, which is round and orange, is too similar to its own. However, a Stephion public relations representative, Friedrich Weber, responded by saying that the two company logos were similar but not similar enough to confuse consumers. Furthermore, Weber maintained that the Stephion design was not problematic because the two companies are in completely different markets. Our in-house legal analyst will join us next.

Thanks for coming in early this morning. I wanted to update you on the café refrigerators that our customers use. We recently installed a new temperature monitoring system. I've noticed that every increase in temperature can be traced to the refrigerator doors being left open for extended periods of time. This is alarming because it compromises the freshness and safety of our food. We all know that customers often take a while to make their selection. I'll be meeting with the management team to discuss ways to address this.

First, I'd like to welcome our new employees. Won-Sahng Kwon has joined the human resources department as a junior associate, and So-Jin Cho is our newest chief of building security. Welcome! Next, I want to inform everyone about an upcoming recommended safety workshop. Links to the registration form have been e-mailed. When filling out the registration form, you do not need to fill in the street address. Leave that field blank. Do enter your work e-mail in the appropriate place. Finally, don't forget that the cafeteria will be closed next week, so you'll need to bring your lunch.

Hi, Marta. This is Oleg from Sola Salon returning your call. You wanted to know about my availability for haircuts—yes, I am accepting new clients. This week, I can fit you in on Wednesday at four o'clock. Please let me know whether that day and time work for you. And in case you didn't know, there's a parking garage with reasonable rates right under our building. A full styling session takes about one and a half hours, so you won't need to park for more than two hours in the garage.

MCAC to Exhibit Alonso’s Works

MAURELY CITY (August 29)—Using recycled materials has become popular with artists, and local sculptor Ida Alonso has happily embraced this trend. Her new exhibition, Throwaways into Treasure, runs from today until November 4 at the Maurely City Art Center (MCAC). Ms. Alonso had the idea for the project while reading about recycled plastic being made into park benches in the Journal for Professional Landscape Architects. She then began to collect old plastic bottles and cardboard shipping boxes and innovatively combined them with commercially made, recyclable building materials.

For the exhibition, Ms. Alonso has created a life-size imitation of commercial offices, with cubicles and partitions made from recovered materials. “By means of my synthetic office space, I am hoping to highlight the idea that old, unwanted objects can take on a new purpose,” Ms. Alonso said. Guests who attend the art show will have the opportunity to bring in their own recyclable plastic items and place them in large collection bags set up around the perimeter of the exhibition room. Ms. Alonso also plans to add more recyclable material to her installation as the show progresses.

Although MCAC will be the only venue for Ms. Alonso’s show, the exhibition is expected to travel in a different sense. On the exhibition’s final day, the works will be dismantled, and all the recyclable materials, including the items brought by visitors, will be transported to a Flyner Industries facility, where they will be shredded and transformed into material for waterproof curtains.

MCAC is open daily from 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. Admission to the art center is free. In addition to Ms. Alonso’s show, works by several local art students will be on view in MCAC’s main gallery.

questions.stem: What will the listeners do next?

questions.stem: What does the speaker remind the listeners to do?

questions.stem: What project does the speaker mention?

questions.stem: What does the speaker assure the listeners of?

questions.stem: What does the company make?

questions.stem: How is the company different from its competitors?

questions.stem: Why should the listeners visit a Web site?

82. - Dẫn chứng: "To get your order started, just enter your information on our Web site." (Để bắt đầu đơn đặt hàng của bạn, chỉ cần nhập thông tin của bạn trên trang web của chúng tôi.)
- Paraphrase: To get your order started (Để bắt đầu đơn đặt hàng của bạn) = To start an order (Để bắt đầu một đơn đặt hàng).

questions.stem: What is the focus of the podcast?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "the housing market has had its ups and downs in recent years." (thị trường nhà ở đã có những thăng trầm trong những năm gần đây.)

questions.stem: What does the speaker say Rebecca Taylor is known for?

84. - Dẫn chứng: "Ms. Taylor is widely known for her ability to correctly predict trends in the real estate market." (Cô Taylor được biết đến rộng rãi với khả năng dự đoán chính xác các xu hướng trên thị trường bất động sản.)
- Paraphrase: correctly predict trends (dự đoán chính xác các xu hướng) = Predicting market trends (Dự đoán xu hướng thị trường).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what will Ms. Taylor do in Chicago?

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the workshop?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "The topic for today's workshop is writing business correspondence." (Chủ đề cho hội thảo hôm nay là viết thư tín kinh doanh.)

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say, “we don't want to offend our clients”?

options.text: To stress the importance of some guidelines
To propose that a meeting be rescheduled

questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "emojis are considered inappropriate in business writing... we don't want to offend our clients." (biểu tượng cảm xúc được coi là không phù hợp trong văn bản kinh doanh... chúng tôi không muốn xúc phạm khách hàng của mình.)
- Paraphrase: (Nói để nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của các quy tắc) = To stress the importance of some guidelines (Để nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của một số hướng dẫn).

questions.stem: What are the listeners asked to do?
questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "rewrite the e-mails using wording and style appropriate for business correspondence." (viết lại các email bằng cách sử dụng từ ngữ và phong cách phù hợp với thư tín kinh doanh.)
- Paraphrase: rewrite the e-mails (viết lại các email) = Rewrite some e-mails (Viết lại một số email).

questions.stem: Why is Clementine Stores in the news report?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "athletic retailer Clementine Stores has filed a complaint against software firm Stephion." (nhà bán lẻ đồ thể thao Clementine Stores đã đệ đơn khiếu nại chống lại công ty phần mềm Stephion.)

questions.stem: According to the report, what do the companies have in common?
questions.explanation:
90. - Dẫn chứng: "Clementine claims that the Stephion logo... is too similar to its own." (Clementine tuyên bố rằng logo Stephion... quá giống với logo của chính nó.)

questions.stem: Who is Friedrich Weber?

questions.stem: Where does the speaker most likely work?

92. - Dẫn chứng: "I wanted to update you on the café refrigerators that our customers use." (Tôi muốn cập nhật cho bạn về tủ lạnh quán cà phê mà khách hàng của chúng tôi sử dụng.)

- Paraphrase: the cafeteria will be closed next week (quán ăn tự phục vụ sẽ đóng cửa vào tuần tới) = A cafeteria will be closed (Một quán ăn tự phục vụ sẽ bị đóng cửa).

questions.explanation: Cụm từ minor errors (lỗi nhỏ/lỗi không đáng kể) là một cách diễn đạt cố định thường gặp khi nói về các biên bản cuộc họp.

questions.stem: Patrons are asked to silence their phones ------- the show begins.
questions.explanation: Liên từ when (khi) dùng để chỉ mốc thời gian khách hàng cần tắt chuông điện thoại (ngay khi buổi diễn bắt đầu).

questions.stem: The majority of the company's employees commute to work ------- train.

questions.explanation: Trạng từ continuously (một cách liên tục) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "operating", chỉ một tuyến xe buýt hoạt động không ngừng nghỉ suốt lịch sử thành phố.

questions.explanation: Danh từ reminder (lời nhắc nhở) phù hợp nhất với mục đích của tin nhắn là nhắc khách hàng đến lấy bưu kiện.

questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ who dùng để thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người "customers" và làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề quan hệ phía sau.

questions.stem: Mr. Takajian may be an entry-level employee, ------- he does not hesitate to take initiative.
questions.explanation: Liên từ but (nhưng) dùng để nối hai vế mang ý nghĩa tương phản: dù là nhân viên mới vào nghề nhưng vẫn rất chủ động.

questions.stem: Carter Department Store allows customers ------- items on hold for up to 24 hours.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc allow someone to do something (cho phép ai đó làm gì). Sau tân ngữ "customers" cần dạng nguyên mẫu có "to": to place.

questions.stem: Using unique colors and styles, the decor experts at Mamie's Interiors bring a ------- look to homes.
questions.explanation: Tính từ fashionable (thời thượng/hợp thời trang) phù hợp nhất để mô tả "vẻ ngoài" (look) mà các chuyên gia trang trí mang lại cho ngôi nhà.

questions.stem: ------- efficient project management, Sparkware's latest software program was released on time.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ Because of (Bởi vì) đứng trước một cụm danh từ để chỉ nguyên nhân (quản lý dự án hiệu quả) dẫn đến kết quả chương trình ra mắt đúng hạn.

questions.stem: The summer line of outdoor furniture will be available ------- select stores as early as February.
questions.explanation: Giới từ at được dùng để chỉ địa điểm cụ thể (tại các cửa hàng được chọn). Cụm "at select stores" rất phổ biến trong bán lẻ.

questions.stem: There has been a ------- decrease in requests for customer support this quarter.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ "a" và trước danh từ "decrease" cần một tính từ. Noticeable (đáng kể/có thể nhận thấy) mô tả mức độ giảm sút của các yêu cầu hỗ trợ.

questions.stem: Bina Dal always wanted to become a diplomat, ------- she studied international relations at university.
questions.explanation: Liên từ so (vì vậy) dùng để nối mệnh đề chỉ nguyên nhân (muốn làm nhà ngoại giao) và kết quả (học quan hệ quốc tế).

questions.stem: Thank you for responding ------- with information about the T-Max 400 printer and scanner.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ promptly (nhanh chóng) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "responding", thường dùng trong thư từ để cảm ơn đối tác phản hồi nhanh.

questions.stem: Owing to the weather, we need to ------- your appointment for tree removal service.
questions.explanation: Động từ reschedule (đổi lịch) phù hợp nhất với ngữ cảnh thời tiết xấu khiến một cuộc hẹn dịch vụ không thể diễn ra như dự định.

questions.stem: It will require a ------- effort between the two countries to complete the railway line.

Câu trước nói về ý kiến tích cực (tốt hơn các mùa trước), câu sau nói về ý kiến trái chiều (mất sức hút). Liên từ "In contrast" (Ngược lại) dùng để nối hai luồng quan điểm đối lập này.

Ở đoạn trước, một số nhà phê bình đã đưa ra những nhận xét tiêu cực (gây nhầm lẫn, mất sức hút). Đạo diễn phản hồi lại những ý kiến này, nên danh từ "criticism" (lời chỉ trích/phê bình) là từ phù hợp nhất.
